parties: HT Media Limited and Next Mediaworks Limited
headline: HT Media / Next Mediaworks: SEBI Takeover Disclosure Filed
sum: HT Media or affiliate has filed a Regulation 31 disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations relating to Next Mediaworks Limited, indicating a substantial acquisition of shares or change in control is in progress or anticipated.
detail: HT Media Limited submitted a Regulation 31(4) and 31(5) disclosure to NSE in June 2026 regarding Next Mediaworks Limited. The specific terms of the acquisition-including acquisition price, percentage of stake, acquirer identity, and timeline to completion-are contained in the filed disclosure document. Regulation 31 disclosures are mandatory when a person or group acquires or announces intent to acquire 25% or more of voting capital, or where the stock exchanges are notified of a formal offer.
